title: Uncle Emile Bigard's bands, West End Bungalow
summary: Personnel of the West End Bungalow band with the uncle on violin and the other bands he played in, including Sidney Desvignes, King Oliver and Kid Ory.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel

blocks.x: They had Walter Deku on piano. Emile Biggoin on violin. And they had Bill Matthews was playing drum.

And they had Joe Howard playing trumpet. Was there a clarinet did you mention? Yes. No. No. Who was the clarinet? Who was the clarinet? Was there a clarinet did you mention? The clarinet player was uh, The clarinet player was uh, Louis Nelson. Biggoin. Oh yeah. Oh yeah. Can you tell us anything about your, anything else about your uncle? Uh, when did he die about? I don't even know. No. Actually, you wouldn't know, but I just wondered if you ever talked to me about it, you know? That's right. Or what other bands he played in, if you remember? I know he played with Sidney Disney and Big Arts Orchestra. They had a band of his own. He had his own band. And he played with King Oliver and Mud Carry and Oris.
